content:
{
  "root_cause": "The datepicker's keydown listener on the input field prevents the default Tab key behavior, trapping focus inside the datepicker popup and preventing movement to the next form field.",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify the datepicker's keydown listener to allow the Tab key to bubble up and trigger the browser's default focus traversal, while preserving all other key handling for datepicker navigation.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "js/Datepicker.js",
      "sha256": "26c130b5380a4d36ae7de5ca8e06affc4ed327048a689e12fc9a8804eb63b595",
      "before": "    const keydownListener = [element, 'keydown', onKeydown.bind(null, this)];",
      "after": "    const keydownListener = [element, 'keydown', function(ev) {\n      if (ev.key === 'Tab') {\n        return;\n      }\n      onKeydown.call(null, this, ev);\n    }.bind(this)];"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Pressing Tab while the datepicker is open will move focus to the next focusable element in the tab order (the Access notes input), enabling keyboard-only users to navigate the form without mouse interaction.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "The datepicker may lose internal keyboard navigation if the Tab key was previously used for popup navigation (though unlikely given arrow key usage).",
    "Shift+Tab behavior is not explicitly addressed but will follow the same pattern as Tab due to the key check.",
    "If the datepicker relies on Tab for internal popup navigation (e.g., moving between grid cells), this could break that functionality. However, the observed datepicker uses arrow keys for navigation, making this risk low."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Tab key moves focus from visit-date input to notes input when datepicker is open.",
    "Shift+Tab moves focus from notes input to visit-date input when datepicker is open.",
    "Arrow right and Enter keys still function to change the date (regression guard).",
    "Datepicker remains operable via arrow keys, Enter, and Escape for date selection and dismissal."
  ]
}
